subject: Ribosome rescue factor Pelota extends lifespan and counters age-related pathology across species
script: From Agewell Brief: Ribosome rescue factor Pelota extends lifespan and counters age-related pathology across species. New research reveals that Pelota, a ribosome-associated quality control factor, promotes longevity by preventing mTOR hyperactivation and preserving autophagy-mediated proteostasis. Pelota is required for longevity in C. elegans. It mitigates senescence, muscle aging, and Alzheimer's neuropathology. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
